question: Should `/status` change from showing a last-reply estimated cost to showing cumulative transcript-backed session cost for the active session?
rationale: Current docs and source describe `/status` cost as an estimated per-session snapshot/last-reply value, while this issue and the linked PR ask to promote cumulative transcript cost into the default status display; that semantics change needs maintainer intent before automation opens another fix or closes the request.

options.title: Adopt cumulative session cost
options.body: Land or rework the linked PR so `/status` and `openclaw status` use transcript-summed `usage.cost.total` when available and document the billing caveat clearly.

options.title: Keep last-reply status cost
options.body: Close this request and the linked PR after documenting that cumulative cost belongs in `/usage cost` or Control UI rather than default status output.

options.title: Narrow the display surface
options.body: Expose cumulative session cost only in the CLI sessions table, verbose status, or another explicit view if maintainers think default `/status` would overstate billing authority.

recommendation.title: Adopt cumulative session cost
recommendation.body: Land or rework the linked PR so `/status` and `openclaw status` use transcript-summed `usage.cost.total` when available and document the billing caveat clearly.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected current-main owner for the status/transcript surface and adjacent billing UX direction in the available history.
